title: Independent adversarial review of the F6-R4/F6-R9 fixes gating the Story 1.2 freeze
summary: Perform a fresh read-only adversarial review of the Story 1.2 mutation-lock protocol after the F6-R4 and F6-R9 corrections: the owner-record judge now reads the record once and judges those bytes instead of taking a raceable second observation, and reclamation reporting moved to the destruction itself so a reclaimer that loses the subsequent take still reports what it removed, alongside a fail-closed shellcheck sub-gate and rewritten contract passages. Independently attack the single-read judge, the exactly-once reclamation reporting under every reclaim outcome, their interaction with the F6-R1 publication-window wait and the F6-R2/R3 vanished-record handling, stale reclaim, N-way contention, owner and reclaimer interleavings, process death, identity changes, and all prior F6 scenarios. Evaluate the documented residual risks including the pre-read hazard guard and the reclaiming-refusals finding, verify the new regressions are genuine and anti-vacuous, sweep for remaining members of the observe-then-act defect class, then rerun every Story 1.2 gate including repeated loaded mutation-gate runs and git diff --check. This review gates the story freeze decision. Report findings only; do not modify repository files.
